## Summary

Dovecote Learning Ltd (policy CC-1629): theft overnight of a soldering station and an oscilloscope from a locked office at a rented studio on Pike Street. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 5,876 dollars.

## Facts

Dovecote Learning Ltd reported the loss on 16 April 2026 under policy CC-1629 [notice of loss]. The loss was a theft overnight from a locked office at a rented studio on Pike Street [notice of loss], [police report]. The items are a soldering station and an oscilloscope [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 18 April 2026, under reference CR/2026/4221 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The soldering station is invoiced at 4,829 dollars [invoice 1] and the oscilloscope at 1,047 dollars [invoice 2]. The file does not state the date of the theft itself.

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents caused by theft, at the named premises and at any other premises while in the insured's custody [policy]. The loss is a theft of business equipment from an office at the studio on Pike Street [notice of loss], [police report].

- **Exclusion 7.1 (unattended property)** does not apply. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless it was in a locked container or locked room. The items were in a locked container, and the theft was from a locked office [police report], [policy].
- **Exclusion 7.3 (wear and tear)** does not apply. The loss is a theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].
- **Exclusion 7.5 (unproven loss)** does not apply on the file as it stands. The police report is dated 18 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss on 16 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. That is within seven days [policy]. The file gives no date for the theft, so the seven days are measured from the notice of loss.

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 5,876 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,829 dollars and 1,047 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 applies an excess of 250 dollars only where the policy schedule shows one, and otherwise none applies [policy]. The file contains no schedule showing an excess, so none is deducted. If a schedule applying the excess exists, the reserve falls to 5,626 dollars.
